name: Hermanus
blurb: Hermanus is recognized as a prime location for land-based whale watching along South Africa's Whale Coast. Visitors also highlight local features such as the cliff path walk, Fernkloof Nature Reserve, and nearby wine tasting in the Hemel-en-Aarde valley.

positive: Incredible close-up views of whales breaching right from the shore
Beautiful coastal scenery, mountain hikes, and nature reserves
Great local spots including art galleries, bakeries, and wine farms
negative: Coastal road closures due to heavy smoke and poor visibility from fires

quotes.text: The bay was full this year. I'll post a video later. Whales breach, I spin 360⁰ to show how close to shore they are (practically in Hermanus  main square) and another  breaches as I come full circle. I had a huge smile on my face.

Hermanus Day Trip from Cape Town
~2 hrs luxury drive. Famous land-based whale watching (Jun–Nov), Cliff Path walk, Grotto Beach, Old Harbour Museum & Hemel-en-Aarde wine tasting.
